allot.subject: Acquisition
allot.text: The Company has been allotted 5,15,954 equity shares of Rs. 10/- each fully paid up pursuant to Rights Issue in the Joint venture i.e. M/s. ZF LIFETEC Rane Automotive India Private Limited.

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Rane Holdings Limited has informed the Exchange regarding preferential allotment of  338030 convertible warrants to members of the Promoter / Promoter Group.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: This is to inform that BSE and NSE vide their respective letters dated July 23, 2026, have granted their  in-principle  approval for preferential issue of 3,38,030 convertible warrants of face value of Rs.10/- each to the Promoters.

allot.subject: Acquisition
allot.text: This is to inform that the Company has acquired 42,81,740 equity shares of face value Rs.10/- each in ZF Lifetec Rane Automotive India Private Limited pursuant to allotment under Scheme of Demerger approved by the National Company Law Tribunal, Chennai Bench.

allot.subject: Acquisition
allot.text: This is to inform you that Rane Steering Systems Private Limited, wholly owned subsidiary of the Company has allotted further 20,00,000 equity shares of Rs.10/- each fully paid up to the Company on Rights basis.

allot.subject: Acquisition
allot.text: This is to inform you that, Rane (Madras) Limited ( RML ) has allotted 59,58,439 equity shares of face value Rs.10/- each on April 23, 2025, pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation of Rane Engine Valve Limited and Rane Brake Lining Limited with and into Rane (Madras) Limited. Shares of the Company in RML, post allotment is 1,76,31,213 Equity shares representing 63.80% of post amalgamated issued and paid-up equity share capital of the Company.
